lines.text: The LORD sent Isaiah and Shear-jashub to meet Ahaz, because Aram and Ephraim planned to crown the son of Tabeal.
The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is the son of Jotham.
The LORD told Ahaz to ask for a sign, but he refused, so Isaiah said the Lord Himself would give one.
